# jupiterone_control_framework_stats (Data Source)

Compliance statistics for one or more CCM frameworks: the scorecard numbers behind the framework compliance view.

These results are read from the graph, which is eventually consistent. An object created earlier in the same apply may not appear yet; a later plan or apply will show it. Do not rely on this data source to observe a change made moments earlier in the same run.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The scorecard numbers behind the framework compliance view.
data "jupiterone_control_framework_stats" "soc2" {
  framework_ids = [jupiterone_control_framework.soc2.id]
}

locals {
  soc2_stats = one(data.jupiterone_control_framework_stats.soc2.stats)
}

output "soc2_posture" {
  value = {
    passing = local.soc2_stats.number_of_passing_controls
    failing = local.soc2_stats.number_of_failing_controls

    # A subset of the passing count: controls passing on a signed attestation
    # rather than on a test result.
    attested = local.soc2_stats.number_of_attested_controls

    # Controls with no test attached are not being evaluated at all.
    untested = local.soc2_stats.number_of_controls - local.soc2_stats.number_of_controls_with_tests

    failing_critical_requirements = local.soc2_stats.number_of_failing_critical_requirements
  }
}

# Omitting framework_ids reports on every framework.
data "jupiterone_control_framework_stats" "everything" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `framework_ids` (List of String) The frameworks to report on. With none given, every framework is reported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A generated identifier for this result set.
- `stats` (Attributes List) Statistics per framework. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stats))

<a id="nestedatt--stats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stats`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the framework these statistics describe.
- `number_of_attested_controls` (Number) How many controls are covered by a valid attestation. A subset of number_of_passing_controls, reported separately so attestation coverage is visible distinctly from raw pass and fail counts.
- `number_of_controls` (Number) How many controls the framework contains.
- `number_of_controls_with_tests` (Number) How many of the framework's controls have at least one control test.
- `number_of_failing_controls` (Number) How many of the framework's controls are failing.
- `number_of_failing_critical_requirements` (Number) How many of the framework's CRITICAL priority requirements are failing.
- `number_of_failing_requirements` (Number) How many of the framework's requirements are failing.
- `number_of_passing_controls` (Number) How many of the framework's controls are passing.
- `number_of_passing_requirements` (Number) How many of the framework's requirements are passing.
- `number_of_requirements` (Number) How many requirements the framework contains.
- `section_stats` (Attributes List) Per-section requirement statistics. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stats--section_stats))

<a id="nestedatt--stats--section_stats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stats.section_stats`

Read-Only:

- `number_of_failing_requirements` (Number) How many of the section's requirements are failing.
- `number_of_passing_requirements` (Number) How many of the section's requirements are passing.
- `number_of_requirements` (Number) How many requirements the section contains.
- `section_name` (String) The name of the section.
